Noah (AE): Handing off Cardinal Labs — deal signed. Target: Dedicated w/ private peering in us-west-2. Must-haves: SAML SSO, customer-managed KMS, audit export to their SIEM, and tenant isolation. They want a short clinician pilot next Thursday. Renewal window Q3; procurement lead time noted as a renewal risk if onboarding slips >18 days. Need CSM owner + clear CS->eng escalation path.

Priya (CSM): I can own onboarding and the enablement. Can someone drop the AWS account ID, SAML metadata, and any model footprint guidance? I'll also prepare a short checklist for security and a feedback loop to capture clinician quality issues.

Ethan (Platform SE): Staging cluster ready in dedicated-usewest2. Missing their VPC CIDR & SAML metadata. Recommend int8 quant variant for pilot to reduce cost. I'll post SG & route snippets to the infra ticket.

Rina (Support): Opening infra ticket now: <https://redwood.example.com/tickets/72111|ticket-72111>. Tags: cardinallabs, dedicated, siem, kms. Assigning to Ethan + infra-team. ETA triage ~4h. infra-bot will post updates. :gear: 

Noah (AE): Customer contact: ops@cardinallabs.ai, AWS acct 444555666777. Sam (customer) asked for a 1:1 enablement and a smoke test before PHI ingestion. Also asked about cost-saving levers (batching, KV prefix cache). Priya - please include Optimize tips.

Priya (CSM): Tentatively scheduling enablement Thu 11am PT after peering validated. Owners: Priya = CSM/onboarding; Ethan = infra; Rina = support/triage; Noah = sales escalation & DPA follow-up. I'll also add a renewal_watch flag in CRM given procurement sensitivity.

infra-bot: ticket-72111 status: created -> triage_pending. Next update ~3-4h.

Rina (Support): Linked onboarding doc: https://redwood.example.com/onboard/cardinallabs. I'll mark demo blocked until peering + SAML metadata validated and will run the smoke test once connectivity is green. I'll post results here. :white_check_mark:

Priya (CSM): Post-demo plan: collect a 4-question feedback form, capture any model quality regressions and route critical items to Research. I'll also run the short Optimize checklist during enablement to show batching/quantization benefits.

Noah (AE): FYI customer asked about SLA for dedicated pool and expected p95 latency. Ethan - can you prepare a short note on expected latency and availability for pilot? Also confirm whether Splunk forwarding is supported (they asked).

Ethan (Platform SE): Will prepare a one-pager on p95 targets + availability and confirm Splunk forwarding steps (we support via the audit-forwarder; will include config).

Priya (CSM): Action recap: 1) Rina -> create/triage ticket-72111 and validate peering. 2) Ethan -> upload SG/KMS/Splunk config + model footprint. 3) Priya -> send invite after peering validated & prep enablement deck + feedback form. 4) Noah -> DPA + procurement follow-up. Ping here if anything blocks.
